title: One Timer, Four Unlock Buttons: No More All-Day Overrides | vitalii.no
description:
The QR-pass flow for unlocking YouTube and Spotify already shut itself off after 30 minutes. But three other admin paths into the same tier 2 access — the master switch, the unlock commands, and the direct yt-on and sp-on buttons — had no such timer. Use any of those instead of the QR pass, and the kids could end up with all-day access if I forgot to lock it back myself.

Inside the youtube-gate Cloudflare Worker, every one of those admin entry points now stamps the same 30-minute expiry window the QR-pass flow already used. Once the window elapses, tier 2 falls back to the normal bonus and QR rules automatically — no separate switch to remember, and no new code path to maintain per button. Plain TV access under the master switch stays untouched, since that one is meant to stay free.

All four admin unlock paths now self-expire after 30 minutes, instead of only one of them doing so before.
